title: CNO - Interface Degradation RCA
description: Lane A: partial interface failure. Per device, if it is UP but has >=1 admin-enabled interface oper-down (cno.if.oper_status==2, admin_status==1), emit ONE consolidated card listing the down interfaces (never one-per-interface; disabled ports excluded). Davis CoPilot adds a narrative. Complements Lane B (CNO - Network Dependency Suppression), which handles device/chain outages.

input.query:
timeseries oper = avg(cno.if.oper_status), admin = avg(cno.if.admin_status), by:{sys_name, if_descr}, from:-5m
| fieldsAdd o = arrayLast(oper), a = arrayLast(admin), device = lower(sys_name)
| filter isNotNull(o) and a == 1
| summarize down_list = collectArray(if(o==2, if_descr)), up = countIf(o==1), down = countIf(o==2), by:{device}
| fieldsAdd down_list = arrayRemoveNulls(down_list)
| filter up > 0 and down > 0
| sort down desc

timeseries s=count(cno.if.oper_status), by:{sys_name, `dt.entity.network:device`}, from:-2h | fieldsAdd n=arraySum(s) | filter n>0 | fields device=lower(sys_name), entityId=`dt.entity.network:device` | dedup device

fetch logs, from:-45m | filter `log.source` == "network.config" or `log.source` == "cisco.syslog" | sort timestamp desc | fields ts=formatTimestamp(timestamp, format:"HH:mm:ss"), src=`log.source`, dev=lower(`host.name`), msg=substring(content, from:0, to:150) | limit 40
